DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 説明の中で、聞き直したいところはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was there anything in the explanation you would like to hear again?

DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 内容は分かりました。ただ、あなたに質問する時、名札の名前をどう読めばいいか分からず、声をかけられませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 名札の読みが分からず職員に話しかけづらいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I understood the information. But when I wanted to ask you a question, I did not know how to read the name on your badge, so I could not bring myself to speak to you.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that not knowing how to read the name on the badge made it difficult to approach the staff member. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 名札には「森田」とあります。「もりた」と読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: The badge says “森田.” It is read “Morita.”

DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: もりたさん、ですね。「しんでん」と読んでしまいそうでした。質問するときに、森田さんとお呼びしても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 森田を復唱し名前で呼ぶ許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: Morita, then. I nearly read it as “Shinden.” May I call you Morita when I ask a question?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Repeat the name Morita and ask permission to address the person by name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。名前が分からない時は、「すみません」と声をかけていただいても構いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. If you do not know someone's name, you can also get their attention by saying “Excuse me.”

DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。知らない名前を無理に読まず、先にすみませんと声をかける方法も覚えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不明な名前は無理に読まずすみませんを使うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I will also remember that I can say “Excuse me” first rather than forcing myself to read an unfamiliar name.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will use “Excuse me” instead of struggling to read an unfamiliar name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 聞き直したい時は、説明の途中でもお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please let me know whenever you need something repeated, even during an explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。相手のお名前を間違えたら話しかけてはいけない、と思っていました。読み方を聞いてから、質問してもよいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 読み間違いを恐れず先に読みを聞けると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will. I thought I must not approach someone if I got their name wrong. So it is all right to ask how to read the name first and then ask my question?
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you can ask how to read the name first without being afraid of mispronouncing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのとおりです。分からない点をそのままにせず、お尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: Exactly. Please ask rather than leaving anything unclear.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、今度は自分から声をかけます。森田さん、最後の説明をもう一度聞いてもよいですか。名前を言う練習だけではなく、内容も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 森田さんと声をかけ最後の説明の再説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then next time I will speak up myself. Morita, could I hear the last explanation again? I want to check the information, not just practice saying your name.
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Address the person as Morita and ask them to repeat the last explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: もちろんです。もう一度ご説明します。それでは、こちらの席で続きを伺いましょう。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-023-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Of course. I will explain it again. Let us continue here at this seat. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れの方をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for someone you came with?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人に「津駅の改札前」とだけ伝えました。友人は着いたと言いますが、私は見つけられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 改札前という曖昧な待合せで友人と会えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I only told my friend, “In front of the ticket gates at Tsu Station.” My friend says they have arrived, but I cannot find them.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot meet your friend because the meeting point “in front of the ticket gates” was vague. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お互いに、改札の名前や近くの目印は確かめましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked with each other which ticket gates you mean and any nearby landmarks?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は青い案内板の横です。友人のメッセージには別の鉄道名が書いてあります。同じ改札だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の目印と友人の別鉄道名を比較して食い違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am beside a blue information board. My friend's message mentions a different railway company. I had assumed we meant the same ticket gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Compare your landmark with the different railway name in your friend's message and explain the discrepancy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この駅では待つ場所が複数あります。いったん、お互い改札を出た場所にいるのか確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are several places to wait at this station. First, please check whether both of you are where you have exited the ticket gates.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私はこちらの外側にいます。友人にも内側か外側かを聞きます。勝手に改札へ入り直すのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 改札の内外を互いに確認し入り直さないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I am outside these gates. I will also ask my friend whether they are inside or outside. I will not go back through the gates on my own assumption.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will both check whether you are inside or outside the gates and that you will not go back through them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 外側同士なら、共通の待合せ場所として中央の時計の下をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you are both outside, I can direct you to the central clock as a shared meeting point.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 時計の下に二人とも移ることにします。友人へ送るため、時計がある広場の呼び名を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 共通の時計へ移るため広場の呼称を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will both move to under the clock. Could you tell me the name of the square with the clock so I can send it to my friend?
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what the square is called so you can both move to the same clock. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この案内図では中央広場です。改札名ではなく、中央広場の時計と伝えると区別できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is called Central Square on this map. Saying “the clock in Central Square,” rather than a ticket gate name, will make the location clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 「中央広場の時計の下」と送りました。友人から同じ文の返事が来たので、そこで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 共通の場所を送信し同じ返答を受けてそこで待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I sent, “Under the clock in Central Square.” My friend replied with the same wording, so I will wait there.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you sent the shared location, received the same wording in reply, and will wait there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 待合せ場所がそろいましたね。それでは、お二人でよい一日を。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Now you agree on the meeting point. Have a lovely day together. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 付き添いの方から、最近疲れていると伺いました。ご本人のお話も聞かせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: The person accompanying you told us you have been tired lately. Please tell us about it yourself as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 母は心配して来てくれました。でも、家での様子は私から説明したいです。少しだけ二人で話せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同伴の母と離れて本人として説明する時間を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My mother came because she was worried. But I would like to explain what things are like at home myself. Could just the two of us talk for a little while?
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for time to explain things yourself, apart from your accompanying mother. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 分かりました。お母様には待合でお待ちいただきます。今、どんなことが気になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Certainly. We will ask your mother to wait in the waiting area. What is concerning you at the moment?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 帰宅後すぐ横になりますが、仕事中ずっと眠いわけではありません。母の「一日中寝ている」という説明とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 仕事中の状態と母の一日中寝ているという説明との差を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I lie down as soon as I get home, but I am not sleepy all the time at work. That is different from my mother's explanation that I “sleep all day.”
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between your condition at work and your mother's description of you sleeping all day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 生活のどの部分に変化があったか、ご自身が覚えている範囲で結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell us which parts of your daily life have changed, as far as you remember.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先週から夕食を作る元気がなくなりました。休日は買物へ行けています。全部できなくなったとは言いたくないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 夕食準備の変化と休日の買物能力を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Since last week I have not had the energy to make dinner. I can still go shopping on my days off. I do not want to say that I have become unable to do everything.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the change in preparing dinner separately from your ability to shop on days off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その違いを記録します。診察では、このお話を先生へお伝えしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will record that distinction. May we share what you have told us with the doctor at your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先生には伝えてください。ただ、母へ説明する前には、どの内容を伝えるのか私にも相談してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 医師への共有を認め母への説明前に本人と相談を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please tell the doctor. But before explaining anything to my mother, I would like you to consult me about what information you will share.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Allow the information to be shared with the doctor, and ask to be consulted before anything is explained to your mother. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望を申し送ります。付き添いを診察室へ呼ぶかどうかも、担当と相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass on your wishes. You can also discuss with the staff whether to invite the person accompanying you into the consultation room.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 最初は自分で話し、言葉に詰まった時だけ母に手伝ってもらいたいです。その希望もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 診察では本人が先に話し困った時だけ母の補助を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I would like to speak for myself first and only have my mother help if I get stuck for words. Please pass on that wish too.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you want to speak first at the consultation and have your mother help only when you have difficulty. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご本人のお話と希望を担当へ引き継ぎます。それでは、待合席へご案内します。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass your account and wishes to the staff in charge. Now I will show you to a seat in the waiting area. Take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらのかごは、お会計へお持ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you taking this basket to the checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだ一つ選び直したいです。友人と夕食を作りますが、この肉は友人の指定なので動かさず、私が選んだ野菜だけ替えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人指定の肉を保持し本人が選んだ野菜だけ変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I still want to change one item. I am making dinner with a friend. My friend specified this meat, so I want to leave it as it is and change only the vegetables I chose.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to keep the meat your friend specified and change only the vegetables you chose. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 替えたい野菜は、どちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which vegetable would you like to change?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この大きなかぼちゃです。料理を担当する友人から、切る時間がないと今連絡が来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 丸かぼちゃを切る時間がないという連絡を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This large pumpkin. My friend, who is doing the cooking, has just messaged to say there is no time to cut it up.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you received a message saying there is no time to cut up the whole pumpkin. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: カットされたかぼちゃは、隣の冷蔵棚にあります。量をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is cut pumpkin in the refrigerated section beside this one. Please check the quantity.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 丸ごとの代わりに、この切った一袋にします。二人分を作るのですが、足りるかどうかは友人に聞いてから買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: カット一袋を候補にして量は調理担当へ確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will choose this bag of cut pumpkin instead of a whole one. We are cooking for two, but I will ask my friend whether it is enough before buying it.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that one bag of cut pumpkin is your proposed choice and that you will check the quantity with the person cooking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お連れの方へご確認ください。元のかぼちゃは、こちらで売場へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check with your companion. We will put the original pumpkin back on the shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 戻していただけて助かります。友人から一袋でよいと返事が来ました。肉の指定も変わっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 店員の返却対応へ礼を述べ一袋承認と肉指定維持を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you; it helps to have you put it back. My friend has replied that one bag is fine. The choice of meat has not changed either.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Thank the staff for returning the pumpkin and say that one bag is approved and the meat choice remains unchanged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、この一袋と、指定されていた肉でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then will it be this one bag and the meat that was specified?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その二点です。別々の希望だったことが分かるよう、帰ったら肉は指定どおり、かぼちゃは相談して替えたと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入二点を確認しそれぞれの選定経緯を友人へ報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Those two items. When I get home, I will say that the meat is as requested and that I changed the pumpkin after discussing it, so my friend knows they reflected separate requests.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the two items being purchased and say that you will tell your friend how each was selected. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご確認ありがとうございます。それでは、お会計へどうぞ。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Please proceed to the checkout. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: コピー機のところで、お困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble at the copier?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三枚の案内を印刷しましたが、一枚目が一番下にあります。文章が逆になったのか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 印刷三枚の一枚目が下にあり文章逆転を心配して相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I printed three pages of information, but the first page is at the bottom. I am worried that the text has been reversed.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help because the first of three printed pages is at the bottom and you are worried the text is reversed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ページ番号は印刷されていますか。文書の中身はこちらへ見せなくても結構です。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are page numbers printed on them? You do not need to show me the document's contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 各ページの下に一、二、三とあります。上からは三、二、一です。文章そのものは直さなくてよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三二一の番号順を示し本文修正の要否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: There is a one, two, or three at the bottom of each page. From the top, they are three, two, one. Does that mean I do not need to change the text itself?
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that the page numbers are in the order three, two, one, and ask whether the main text needs correction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 番号を見て並べ直せば読む順番になります。まず、一の紙を上にしてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you rearrange them by their numbers, they will be in reading order. First, try putting page one on top.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一を上にしました。二と三も続けたら、話がつながりました。もう一度印刷する必要はなさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号で並べ直し再印刷不要と判断した理由を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have put one on top. When I added two and three after it, the text flowed properly. It looks as though I do not need to print it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you rearranged the pages by number and why you decided reprinting was unnecessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 裏面にも印刷しましたか。それとも片面だけですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Did you print on the backs as well, or only on one side?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 片面だけです。裏に続きを探していたので、余計に分からなくなりました。三枚を一組にして持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 片面印刷と裏に続きを探した誤解を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Only on one side. I was looking for the continuation on the backs, which made me even more confused. I will keep the three pages together as one set.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that it is single-sided printing and that you mistakenly looked on the backs for the continuation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 置き忘れがないよう、出てきた紙と持ち物をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the printed pages and your belongings so you do not leave anything behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 三枚そろっています。読み始める面を上にして封筒へ入れ、コピー機の台に残りがないか見てから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 三枚を一組に収め印刷台の置き忘れを確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have all three pages. I will put them in an envelope with the side where I start reading facing up, then check that nothing remains on the copier's surface before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will put the three pages together and check the printing area for anything left behind. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そろったようですね。それでは、お忘れ物にお気をつけて。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: It looks like everything is there. Please be careful not to leave anything behind. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 講座の申込書を拝見します。住所の欄を、もう少し確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let me look at your course application. May I check the address section a little more closely?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 建物の名前と部屋番号を書きました。郵便が届いているので、これで住所になると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 建物名と部屋番号だけで住所欄を満たすと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote the building name and room number. Since my mail arrives, I thought that would count as the address.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the building name and room number alone completed the address section. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この用紙には、町名と番地を書く欄もあります。手元で確認できる物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This form also has a space for the town name and street number. Do you have anything with you that you can check?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自宅に届いた封筒を持っています。建物名の上に町名と数字がありますが、全部こちらへ写しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 届いた封筒の町名と数字を写す範囲を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have an envelope that was delivered to my home. There is a town name and some numbers above the building name. Should I copy all of them here?
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how much of the town name and numbers on the delivered envelope you should copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 町名と番地はこちら、建物名と部屋番号は下の欄です。文字が分からない所は、空けてお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The town name and street number go here; the building name and room number go in the space below. If there are characters you do not understand, leave that part blank and ask.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 町名の読み方は分かりませんが、封筒の字は見えます。読みを想像して別の字にせず、そのまま写してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 読みを知らない町名の漢字を推測せず転記してよいか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not know how to read the town name, but I can see the characters on the envelope. May I copy them as they are, rather than guessing the reading and writing different characters?
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can copy the town-name kanji without guessing how to read them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。読みを記入する欄は別にありません。記入後、封筒と照らし合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. There is no separate space to write the reading. After you fill it in, let us compare it with the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 数字まで写しました。部屋番号を番地の続きに書きそうになりましたが、下の欄へ分けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 番地と部屋番号を別欄に記入したことを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have copied the numbers too. I nearly wrote the room number immediately after the street number, but I put it separately in the lower space.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you entered the street number and room number in separate spaces. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 欄の分け方はこれで大丈夫です。お名前と連絡先も、ご自身で見直してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is the right way to separate the entries. Please review your name and contact information yourself as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 名前と連絡先も確認しました。次からは建物名だけで済ませず、町名、番地、部屋番号を分けて準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 氏名連絡先を見直し次回は住所各部分を分けて用意すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked my name and contact information too. From next time, I will not give just the building name; I will prepare the town name, street number, and room number separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you reviewed your name and contact information and will prepare each address component separately next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 申込書をお預かりします。それでは、講座でお会いできるのを楽しみにしております。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take your application now. We look forward to seeing you at the course. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 配達時のご連絡について、ご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss how you are notified when a delivery arrives, is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。私は呼出しの音が聞こえにくく、家にいても荷物の配達に気付けません。聞こえるまで何度も呼んでほしい、という依頼ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 呼出音に気付けず在宅配達を逃す事情と単なる反復呼出希望ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have difficulty hearing the call sound and cannot notice a parcel delivery even when I am home. I am not asking for someone simply to keep calling until I hear it.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you miss deliveries while at home because you do not notice the call sound, and that you are not simply asking for repeated calls. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 音以外で、どのような案内があれば確認しやすいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: What kind of notification other than sound would be easier for you to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 文字なら分かります。ただ、配達担当の方が私の携帯へ必ずメッセージを送れるとは思っていないので、対応できる方法を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 文字案内が分かりやすいが配達担当の個別送信を当然とせず相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can understand written notifications. But I do not assume the delivery person can always send a message to my phone, so I would like to discuss what methods are available.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that written notifications are easier to understand, but discuss the options without assuming the delivery person can send individual messages. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 個別の連絡方法は、配達担当に確認します。受取り先を変える方法も含めて、希望を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check individual contact methods with the delivery staff. Could you tell me your preferences, including the possibility of changing where you receive it?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 勤務先へ送るのは避けたいです。もし自分で受け取る場所を選べるなら、文字の案内を見て行ける窓口を希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勤務先配送を避け文字案内で行ける窓口受取の希望を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would rather not have it sent to my workplace. If I can choose a collection point myself, I would prefer a counter I can go to using written directions.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to avoid workplace delivery and would prefer collection at a counter you can reach using written directions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この荷物について、受取場所を変更できるか確認します。今、受取り済みではありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check whether the collection location for this parcel can be changed. You have not received it yet, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。不在の紙が入っていましたが、外出していたわけではありません。家にいたけれど音に気付かなかったと伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未受領と在宅だったが呼出音未認知だった経緯を担当へ伝えるよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. A missed-delivery slip was left, but I was not out. Please tell the staff I was home but did not notice the sound.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the staff to pass on that you have not received the parcel and were home but did not notice the call sound. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その事情も担当へ申し送ります。結果は口頭だけではなく、こちらで要点を紙へ書いてお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that on as well. Rather than giving the result only verbally, I will write down the main points here and give them to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 助かります。受取り場所が確定するまでは、近くの窓口へ勝手に行かず返答を待ちます。紙に書かれた場所と方法を見てから動きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更確定前に窓口へ行かず書面の場所方法を確認して行動すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: That will help. Until the collection location is confirmed, I will wait for a reply rather than going to a nearby counter on my own. I will act after checking the location and procedure written on the paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not go to a counter before the change is confirmed and will act after checking the written location and procedure. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご希望と事情を確認できました。それでは、担当へ連絡しますのでこちらでお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I have confirmed your wishes and circumstances. I will contact the staff in charge, so please wait here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お呼びした方ですね。受付札を拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are the person we called, correct? May I see your reception ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私だと思って立ちましたが、今の呼び出しは「佐藤」でしたか、「加藤」でしたか。私は加藤です。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 呼び出しの佐藤と加藤を聞き分け本人の姓を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I stood up because I thought you meant me, but did you just call “Sato” or “Kato”? I am Kato.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether the name called was Sato or Kato, and give your own surname. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 佐藤様とお呼びしました。お手元の札は何番でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I called Sato. What number is on your ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十四番です。姓が一文字違うので、聞き違えたかもしれないと思って先に尋ねました。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付十四番と一文字違いの聞き違い疑いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Fourteen. The surnames differ by one character, so I asked first because I thought I might have misheard.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your reception number is fourteen and that you suspected mishearing surnames differing by one character. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今の方は十二番です。加藤様は十四番でお待ちいただいています。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person we just called is number twelve. You, Kato, are waiting with number fourteen.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十二番の方の順番だったのですね。その方の書類を見ないよう、いったん席へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 十二番の他人の順番と理解し書類を見ず席へ戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: So it was the turn of the person with number twelve. I will return to my seat for now, without looking at their documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show that you understand it was another person's turn, number twelve, and return to your seat without looking at their documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 十四番になりましたら番号とお名前をお呼びします。座る場所は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: When it is time for number fourteen, we will call your number and name. Do you know where to sit?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受付が見える席へ戻ります。次は名前の音だけではなく、十四という番号も聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付が見える席で番号十四も聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will go back to a seat where I can see reception. Next time I will listen for the number fourteen as well, not just the sound of the name.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will sit where you can see reception and listen for the number fourteen too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。先にご確認いただきありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Thank you for checking first.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: こちらこそ。札は自分で持っておきます。似た呼び方でも、確認できるまで他の方の席へ進まないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の札を保持し似た呼び方でも未確認で席へ進まないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you too. I will keep my own ticket with me. Even if a name sounds similar, I will not approach someone else's place until I have checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep your own ticket and not proceed to someone else's place without checking, even if the name sounds similar. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。それでは、十四番のご案内までお待ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: All right. Please wait until we call number fourteen. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 観察会の用紙をお持ちですね。葉の形を調べる課題でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have the observation activity sheet. Is your task to investigate leaf shapes?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもと同じ形の葉を二枚探しています。枝にはありますが、地面では見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 観察課題の同形葉二枚を地面では見つけられないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My child and I are looking for two leaves of the same shape. There are some on the branches, but we cannot find them on the ground.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help because you cannot find two same-shaped leaves for the observation task on the ground. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この観察会では、枝から取らず、落ちた葉を観察します。木に付いた葉も、見るだけなら比べられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this activity, we observe fallen leaves rather than taking them from branches. You can also compare leaves still on trees just by looking at them.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二枚集めるために枝を折るのはやめます。落葉一枚と、木の葉を見て描いた絵でも記録になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 枝を折らず落葉と木の葉の絵の組合せ可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will not break a branch to collect two leaves. Would one fallen leaf and a drawing made while looking at a leaf on the tree count as a record?
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can combine a fallen leaf with a drawing of a leaf on the tree without breaking a branch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日の担当に確認しました。その組合せで大丈夫です。落葉は、こちらの観察台で比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I checked with today's activity leader. That combination is fine. Please compare the fallen leaf at this observation table.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。葉の色が違うので同じ木ではないと思っていましたが、形も見て比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 色だけで樹種を判断せず形を比較したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I thought they were not from the same kind of tree because the leaf colors differ, but I would like to compare their shapes as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you want to compare shapes rather than judging the kind of tree by color alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 先がとがっているか、縁にどんな形があるかを、親子で見つけてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Try looking together with your child at whether the tips are pointed and what shapes the edges have.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらは先が丸く、木の葉は先がとがっています。色だけで同じだと決めず、別々の形として描きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 先端形状の違いから同じと決めず別々に描くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: This one has a rounded tip, while the leaf on the tree has a pointed tip. I will not decide they are the same by color alone, but draw them as different shapes.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will draw the leaves separately because their tips differ, rather than deciding they are the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 描き終わった葉は、観察台へ残してください。ほかの参加者も使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you have finished drawing the leaf, please leave it on the observation table. Other participants will use it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 絵を二つ描きました。葉は持ち帰らず台へ戻し、子どもには枝の葉を残せたことも話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 絵を完成し共有葉を戻し枝の葉を残した意味を子へ話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We have finished two drawings. I will put the leaf back on the table rather than take it home, and tell my child that we were able to leave the leaves on the branches as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you finished the drawings, will return the shared leaf, and will discuss with your child the significance of leaving the leaves on the branches. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、次の観察も親子でお楽しみください。さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Enjoy the next observation activity together. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 年表の途中について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about this part of the timeline?

DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ここで年が二つ飛んでいます。その間は何もしていなかったという意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 年表の欠落期間が活動なしを意味するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two years are skipped here. Does that mean they were not doing anything during that time?
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the missing period in the timeline means there was no activity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何もしていなかったと分かったのではなく、この展示で使える記録が見つかっていない期間です。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: It is not that we know they were doing nothing. It is a period for which no records usable in this exhibition have been found.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 記録がないことと、出来事がなかったことは違うのですね。ノートに「活動なし」と書いたので直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 記録不在と出来事不在を区別しノートの断定を直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: So having no records and having no events are different things. I wrote “no activity” in my notebook, so I will correct it.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the absence of records from the absence of events and correct the definite statement in your notebook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのように区別してください。隣の手紙は、日付の一部が読めない資料です。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please make that distinction. The letter beside it is a document with part of its date illegible.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 手紙の月日は読めても、年は分からないのですか。年表の空白に入る手紙だと考えていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 日付の一部と年の不明を尋ね空白期間との仮説を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: Even though you can read the month and day of the letter, is the year unknown? I had thought it was a letter from the gap in the timeline.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the readable part of the date and the unknown year, and explain your hypothesis that it belongs to the gap. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 展示札にも年不詳とあります。ここでは空白のどの年かまでは結び付けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: The display label also says “year unknown.” Here we have not connected it with any particular year in the gap.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 「年不詳」は年が分からないという意味ですね。勝手に一つの年へ置かず、手紙は別にメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 年不詳を理解し手紙を特定年へ割り当てず記録する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: “Year unknown” means you do not know the year, then. I will note the letter separately rather than assigning it to a year myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that you understand “year unknown” and record the letter without assigning it to a particular year. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 何が資料から分かり、何がまだ分からないかを分けて読むと、理解しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: It becomes easier to understand if you distinguish what the documents tell us from what is still unknown.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ノートを「この期間の記録は展示されていない」に直しました。帰って話す時も、活動がなかったと断定しないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 展示記録不在へ修正し帰宅後も活動なしと断定しないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: I changed my note to “No records from this period are displayed.” When I talk about it after going home, I will also be careful not to state that there was no activity.
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you corrected the note to the absence of exhibited records and will not assert there was no activity when talking about it at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 丁寧に読み直していただきありがとうございます。それでは、引き続きご見学をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-024-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for reading it through again so carefully. Please continue to enjoy the exhibition. Excuse me.
